airfield.layout: airfield v2 (CONTRACTS_G6 s13, sim/systems/airfield.gd layout_for / strip_points): the field building is the main base (a_airfield / b_aerodrome size 2); axis = AXES[facing_i], perp = (-axis.y, axis.x); the apron is the band beside the base on the +perp side (layout.apron, apron_rows x slot_size deep), cut into slot_size squares at layout.slots (draw apron_pads.<style>.<facing_i> centred on each slot square; hangars are real buildings on slot squares); runway k starts at strip_points(k)[0] beyond the apron and runs strip_len tiles along the axis: segment i in 0 .. strip_len-1 is centred at start + axis*(i + 0.5): i = 0 'start', i = strip_len-1 'end', else 'mid'; 'link' tiles fill the 1-tile gap between strip k-1 and k (runway_gap 4, strips 3 wide); a closed strip (crater) shows a crater overlay at its crater segment and 'closed' at i = 1 and i = strip_len-2

state_rules.lvl: hangar.level n (0..3) -> lvl_<n>; under 50% hp lvl_<n>_damaged; under construction build_<0..2>
state_rules.rot: facing_i f -> rot_<f>; under 50% hp rot_<f>_damaged; under construction rot_<f>_build_<0..2>
state_rules.water: water side d of the footprint (AX[d] points at the water cells) -> water_<d>; water_<d>_damaged; water_<d>_build_<0..2>
